name: ENTRANT_POOL
description: Pointer to the list of qualifying national teams (EXEMPT_COUNT fewer than 10), sorted by reputation
evidence: WcOceaniaLeague::build_entrant_pool (0x91fa80) allocates 4 x n bytes into +0xef, fills it with database_get_national_team of the Oceania nations and qsorts it with 0x4b07d0

name: ENTRANT_POOL_COUNT
description: Number of places in ENTRANT_POOL: 10 minus EXEMPT_COUNT
evidence: WcOceaniaLeague::build_entrant_pool (0x91fa80) writes 10, then 10 - [+0xee], and returns 0 unless the pool was filled to this count

name: DRAWN_CLUBS
description: Pointer to the list of the Oceania Nations Cup teams (6 nations); the second group takes places 3, 4 and 5
evidence: OceaniaNations::create_group_stage (0x799a60) copies [[+0xee] + 0xc..0x14] into the 3-team vector of the League_Stage; same layout as african_nations::DRAWN_CLUBS / goldcup::DRAWN_CLUBS
